research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Couture Craft and Techniques
summary: Craft in premium kidswear: artist-designed prints, handcrafted embroidery, handmade costumes and luxury "princess" dressing.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Halcyon Nights builds several graphic universes each season with patterns designed by a panel of artists<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Bobo Choses publishes illustrated books alongside its collections<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Selini Action makes handmade costumes decorated with shells, pebbles, seaweed and embroidery<sup>[2]</sup>.
- Speranza and Junona show luxury "princess" style<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Fatamadrina's "Wildflowers Bloom" uses delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Translating to ready-to-wear
sections.body:
- Artist collaborations on prints.
- Hand embroidery on one placement per garment.
- Smocking and pleating for occasion dresses.

design_implications:
- Budget hand work into hero pieces.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Tell the craft and artist story; price as limited.
